name: University of Roehampton

sources.title: Tier 4 Credibility Interview Guidance (University of Roehampton PDF, 03/2018)
topics: the studies you are planning to undertake in the UK
quotes: Why did you choose Roehampton University?
Why did you choose your course?
How do your studies fit into your career plans?
If the costs of pursuing your course of study are higher in the UK than in your home country, why have you decided to incur the extra costs involved with studying in the UK?
You have previously studied in the UK - why have you chosen to return?
You have had a long break in your studies, why are you returning to study now?
Do you plan to work whilst you study in the UK?
How will you fund your studies?
sources.notes: PDF extracted locally with pypdf (WebFetch could not read it). Home Office staff interview; guidance under each question says interviewer may ask about 'the name and content of modules, course structure (i.e. when modules are studied, how many credits each module is worth etc.) the total number of credits, academic calendar, likely career opportunities and progression'; whether UK family influenced choice; campus vs city lifestyle and knowledge of London; 'maximum of 20 hours per week' work; subsequent years' fees; loan repayment; accommodation cost and cost of living. Interviewer also checks English.

sources.notes: 'The 5 – 10 minute interview will be conducted in English and provide assurance that the English language requirements of the Student visa rules are met.' No example questions; links to the PDF above.
